AI Overview
Dashmetry is a fast-paced, browser-based rhythm platformer inspired by Geometry Dash where you guide a moving geometric icon through music-synced obstacle courses. 
dashmetry.net
 +2
Key Details & Gameplay
Core Mechanics: Your icon moves forward automatically. You time jumps, gravity flips, and flights to match an energetic background soundtrack. 
Game Modes: Includes Classic levels to reach the finish, Endless mode for high scores, and Race modes. 
Customization: Collect coins during runs to unlock custom cube skins, colors, and visual trails in the Icon Kit. 
Level Editor: Allows players to build and remix custom rhythm levels. 
Where to Play
Dashmetry is available to play directly in web browsers like Chrome, Edge, or Firefox without an app store download. 
dashmetry.net
The game transitioned its primary home and leaderboards to Challenge Rush, though you can still practice via Dashmetry Net and WebGames.
